analysis_type: High-precision numerical certification of denominator sign and conservative native exponential prediction envelopes over explicitly defined parameter ellipsoids and continuous held-out distance intervals; no refitting or probability-region claim

region_rule.center: Each frozen native parameter vector b1,b2,b3 exactly as stored; no refitting or center update
region_rule.matrix: The corresponding frozen local parameter covariance matrix is used only to define an ellipsoid and is not interpreted as a posterior or confidence covariance
region_rule.ellipsoid: E={theta:(theta-center)^T C^(-1)(theta-center) <= radius^2}; require symmetric positive-definite C by high-precision Cholesky
region_rule.radius_scope: Radius four is a frozen arithmetic choice, not a confidence level, probability coverage, optimized bound or calibrated uncertainty region
region_rule.support_identity: For any vector g, the maximum of g^T(theta-center) over E is radius*sqrt(g^T C g)
region_rule.related_dataset_scope: Chwirut1 shares its study and native model family with Chwirut2; this is not independent model-family or laboratory replication

denominator_rule.continuous_interval: For each frozen held-out distance interval [a,b], evaluate both endpoints for both bounds; d_min is concave so its minimum occurs at an endpoint and d_max is convex so its maximum occurs at an endpoint
denominator_rule.positive_certificate: Require both outward-rounded endpoint d_min values to be strictly greater than zero; only then certify d(x,theta)>0 over the full ellipsoid and closed continuous interval
denominator_rule.failure: If either endpoint cannot be certified positive, mark the fold unavailable and do not generate a finite prediction or residual bound
denominator_rule.proof_scope: This certifies only the explicitly defined ellipsoid and closed interval, not all parameters, all x or physical reality

prediction_rule.native_model: f(x,theta)=exp(-b1*x)/(b2+b3*x); use the original nonlinear function, not a Taylor approximation
prediction_rule.b1_bounds: Compute b1_min and b1_max from the ellipsoid support in the b1 coordinate
prediction_rule.numerator_bounds: For positive x, numerator_min=exp(-b1_max*x) and numerator_max=exp(-b1_min*x)
prediction_rule.conservative_envelope: When denominator positivity is certified, use f_min=numerator_min/denominator_max and f_max=numerator_max/denominator_min; independent numerator and denominator relaxations may be loose but must remain conservative
prediction_rule.residual_upper_bound: For each observed y, use max(abs(y-f_min),abs(y-f_max)); the observed point residual bound is conditional on the defined ellipsoid and certified denominator positivity
prediction_rule.center_consistency: Require the frozen center prediction to lie inside every available envelope and its actual residual not to exceed the computed upper bound; this is an arithmetic consistency check, not external validation or probability coverage
prediction_rule.width_audit: Report envelope widths and residual upper bounds so that very wide but formally valid bounds cannot be presented as high information

numerical_rule.engine: mpmath with 80 decimal digits of precision and exact decimal conversion of stored input values
numerical_rule.outward_relative_margin: Apply a relative margin of 1e-24 before conversion to binary floats, then use nextafter in the outward direction for every certified lower and upper value
numerical_rule.certificate_class: High-precision numerical interval certificate with outward rounding, not an exact rational-algebra certificate
numerical_rule.positive_definite_check: Fail rather than generate bounds if the covariance matrix is not symmetric positive definite
numerical_rule.failure_preservation: Non-finite values, failed Cholesky, sign failure and unavailable envelopes are retained explicitly

output_rule.word: papers/前沿共生Chwirut1原生椭球连续界_图文完整版.docx

prohibitions: No refitting, changed centers, changed covariance matrices, changed folds or post-hoc radius selection
No Taylor-model substitution for the native exponential prediction envelope
No finite prediction or residual bound when denominator positivity is not certified over the full ellipsoid and continuous interval
No probability, confidence, posterior, calibrated-coverage or physical-endogeneity claim for the ellipsoid or its coverage counts
No use of center-prediction containment or actual-residual coverage as independent scientific validation
No exact rational-certificate claim for the high-precision numerical interval computations
No description of Chwirut1 as independent of the Chwirut2 study or native model family
No hiding of unavailable folds, non-positive denominators, wide envelopes or numerical failures
